object.attr: stakeholder: an agent written for the previous release keeps working. `outline`'s `root` and `depth` were added this way after 0.3.0. Covers what a call writes as well as what it returns (review Q16). MELLON-MCP-SRS-75 is the accepted reason to break this where a default result is too long (review Q10).
object.description: The MCP server should give each parameter added since the previous release a default under which a call leaving the parameter out returns and writes what the previous release did.
